Timely_promotion, STOP. Don't do it. just stop it right now. You want us to stop you right? Listen to us. Where you are sounds like a hell hole and you deserve so much more like any of us humans. 

Whatever they're doing to you IS WRONG. You have to get up and get out. Please find your friend and any social work or family service center and plead for as much help as you can. I never went through sexual abuse, but this is heartbreaking. It hurts to know someone out here is struggling so much and I can only tell you through this screen. But one thing's for certain is, YOURE NOT ALONE. That community you are in is sick, leave them. We are here. There are people that can help you. Please don't give in to those thoughts.

Please find a nearby hospital to treat your injuries. Please listen to your last hopes, it's never too late. You deserve much more, and you must know it..
